title: One unit cancellation at a specified stalk differential
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], y a point, S=Spec(O_{Y,y}), and t:Spec(kappa(y))->S its residue morphism. Let P be a cochain complex [def-pc-derived-category] of O_S-modules supported in degrees 0 through d. Suppose n:Z->N gives free-sheaf sizes [def-weil-pbc-free-module] for P in every degree. Fix a natural number i<d such that the degree i to i+1 differential of t^*P [def-pc-derived-pullback] is nonzero. Then there exist a complex P′ and sizes n′ with P homotopy equivalent to P′, both original support bounds, free terms of the specified sizes, n′(i)+1=n(i), n′(i+1)+1=n(i+1), and n′(j)=n(j) for all other degrees. The cancellation takes place at the supplied degree i; this statement does not locate a nonzero differential.

source.place: Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex), one unit-entry cancellation; blueprint lem-pc-perfect-locus proof step 4. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00MT

proof.text: Choose the supplied free identifications and conjugate the indicated differential to a map φ of finite free sheaves. Its pulled-back conjugate δ is nonzero by cancellation of the pulled-back isomorphisms. A map of finite free sheaves with zero matrix is zero: write the identity as the finite sum of coordinate projection followed by inclusion, and use naturality to determine each unit-sheaf endomorphism by its value at 1 on the terminal open. Therefore freeMatrix δ has a nonzero coefficient.

The proved upstream freeMatrix_pullback formula identifies this coefficient with g.appTop applied to the same coefficient a of φ. Naturality of ΓSpecIso identifies that image with the residue of ΓSpecIso(a). The residue-ne-zero criterion for the local stalk proves ΓSpecIso(a) is a unit; the inverse global-sections ring isomorphism proves a is a unit.

Apply [lem-pc-affine-free-complex-unit-cancellation] with the supplied pivot indices and this unit coefficient. It gives a homotopy equivalent complementary complex, explicit sizes decreased by one at the two specified degrees, and termwise isomorphisms with the original complex elsewhere.

Set n\prime(j) to n(j)-1 at i and i+1 and to n(j) elsewhere. Below 0 and above d neither cancelled degree occurs, since 0≤i<i+1≤d; transfer the original zero terms along the supplied unchanged-term isomorphisms. This proves both strict support bounds. The two Fin pivot indices prove n(i)>0 and n(i+1)>0, so natural subtraction yields n\prime(i)+1=n(i) and n\prime(i+1)+1=n(i+1). The remaining rank equations are the other branch of the definition of n\prime.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stalk_unit_cancellation_at {Y : Scheme.{u}} (y : Y)
    (P : CochainComplex (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d) (n : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hfree : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty
      (P.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n j)))))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < d)
    (hne :
      (((Modules.pullback (Spec.map (Y.residue y))).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        P).d (i : ℤ) ((i : ℤ) + 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (P' : CochainComplex (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).Modules ℤ)
      (n' : ℤ → ℕ),
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P P') ∧
      P'.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P'.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty
        (P'.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n' j))))) ∧
      n' (i : ℤ) + 1 = n (i : ℤ) ∧
      n' ((i : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = n ((i : ℤ) + 1) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ (i : ℤ) → j ≠ (i : ℤ) + 1 → n' j = n j)
